title: Call tracking for small business ads

facts.fact: One unnamed call tracking provider lists tracking numbers from $0.50 a month each, plus per-minute charges (vendor's own published price).
facts.unit: USD per month per tracking number
facts.quote: One provider lists tracking numbers from $0.50 a month each plus per-minute charges

facts.fact: That same unnamed provider says a typical small business with three to five numbers spends $30 to $75 a month in usage on top of the plan.
facts.quote: says a typical small business with three to five numbers spends $30 to $75 a month in usage on top of the plan.

facts.fact: Analytic Call Tracking's small-business guide lists a lower-tier plan at $22 a month (third-party claim as reported by this page).
facts.quote: Analytic Call Tracking’s small-business guide lists a lower-tier plan at $22 a month.

facts.fact: WhatConverts' 2026 software roundup lists one full-featured call tracking tool starting at $30 a month (third-party claim as reported by this page).
facts.quote: lists one full-featured tool starting at $30 a month.

facts.fact: Adwave states that on its platform a daily budget from $30 to $10,000 covers media, ads, and management, with no subscription; call tracking software is billed separately by its own provider.
facts.quote: On Adwave, a daily budget from $30 to $10,000 covers media, ads, and management, with no subscription.

facts.fact: Google Ads offers AI analysis of call recordings to judge lead quality, but only where recording is available, limited to the U.S. and Canada (per the page's reading of Google's support page).
facts.quote: AI analysis of the recording where recording is available (U.S. and Canada only)
